title: fix: keep pricing off X, Reddit, LinkedIn and Instagram
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The social pipeline now routes price, Pollen balance, and Quest/Paid eligibility changes to per-PR Discord posts and Enter model news, not X, Reddit, LinkedIn, or Instagram. Daily and weekly recaps no longer receive model announcements; per-PR Discord posts retain the exact model values. PRs that only change pricing or eligibility are marked publish_tier: none and stay out of recaps.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden newsroom, Polli wears a tiny editor's visor and sorts little model-news cards toward a glowing Discord terminal and an Enter noticeboard, while recap pages rest beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium within the scene, never oversized, with consistent rounded proportions, strictly pixel art and never realistic, against soft pastel gradients and warm lighting in a cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic with retro gaming vibes.
